scientific_limitations: Assumes an irreducible symmetric doubly stochastic discrete-time walk, permitted self-loops, and the Möbius ladder family. Zero-target Kemeny convention. title: Kemeny-optimal stochastic walks on Möbius ladders: a two-thirds rung law
